readings: Group sentimentandfundamentals by eventannotm, treating NULL as its own group. Compute each group's average instntownpct (instownpct), ignoring NULL ownership values. Compute the overall average as the mean of instownpct over all rows with non-NULL ownership. Keep the timing groups whose average is strictly above that overall row-level average. In one row, return the mean of those groups' average ownership and the mean of (group average minus overall row-level average) for those groups, unrounded.

Group sentimentandfundamentals by eventannotm, treating NULL as its own group. Compute each group's average instownpct, ignoring NULL ownership values. Compute the overall average as the mean of these group averages, with each timing group weighted equally. Keep the timing groups whose average is strictly above that mean of group averages. In one row, return the mean of those groups' average ownership and the mean of (group average minus the mean of group averages) for those groups, unrounded.
queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS gavg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
  HAVING COUNT(instownpct) > 0
),
o AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS oavg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(g.gavg) AS avg_group_ownership,
       AVG(g.gavg - o.oavg) AS avg_diff
FROM g, o
WHERE g.gavg > o.oavg;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS a
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
),
m AS (
  SELECT AVG(a) AS mean_a FROM g
)
SELECT AVG(g.a) AS avg_ownership, AVG(g.a - m.mean_a) AS avg_diff
FROM g, m
WHERE g.a > m.mean_a;
